propositions: CLI reference documentation and distribution checks must derive exclusively from runtime registries and committed parser artifacts, eliminating regex parsing and hand-maintained command census.
gen_cli_help.py --check and gen_cli_reference.py --check must prove byte-currency of generated syntax/options sections against actual parser behavior.
Clean-wheel CI validation must execute no-extras wheel build, run generator checks, render all approved help forms, and assert no heavy imports or handler execution.
Full-runtime-extra contract must resolve all lazy handler/parser/selector references and validate every capability-to-extra mapping without executing command logic.
Editorial examples and cross-command rationale must be structurally separated from generated syntax and linted for registry spelling validity.
